visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabbed pricing panels, each tab can hold several plan cards
visualCharacteristics.layout: horizontal tab list; panel content split into plan cards at each H3; 1 column on mobile, 3 on desktop

contentPattern.structure: One row per tab: cell 1 tab label, cell 2 panel content. Inside a panel start each plan with an H3 plan name, then the price as a bold paragraph, notes, description, list and Buy now / Learn more links. Content before the first H3 becomes the panel intro

reuseGuidance: Use for pricing plan comparisons grouped by audience. The first tab with content is selected by default; empty tabs are allowed.
